function first<T>(value:ArrayLike<T>):T {return value[0];}
const value=first({0:3,length:1});
const upper=Array.from({0:'hi',length:1}, value=>value.toUpperCase());
interface Indexed {readonly [index:number]:number;length:number}
const indexed:Indexed={0:4,length:1};
const indexedValue=first(indexed);
const text=first('hi');
const tuple:[number,number]=[5,6];
console.log(value.toFixed(),upper.join(','),indexedValue.toFixed(),text.toUpperCase(),first(tuple).toFixed());
